integrity: Analytic proof and independent exact-rational consistency checker supplied; finite checking is not infinite proof.
limitations: Equal-step stochastic extragradient on an unconstrained scalar-bilinear game in dimension two.
IID within-iteration pairs over time, equal marginal laws with nonzero mean and finite fourth moment.
Mean-square stability only; no pathwise, high-dimensional matrix or nonlinear generalization claimed.
Publication precedence remains subject to independent specialist verification.
title: A sharp one-half sample-reuse threshold for stochastic extragradient on bilinear games
